objective: The intro (decision 0116, beta blocker 11): the Ranger's loan of four legends, a first fight that cannot be lost with four lessons, the goodbye, and three starter eggs that hatch in seconds.
acceptance_criteria: A save that has not done the intro sees only the Ranger's card; a save from before the intro that has played never sees it
The borrowed fight is won whatever the player presses, and no legend is knocked out (spec)
The intro ends once, by the server, with three starter eggs of the three classes hatching in 5 seconds; skipping gives the same
The borrowed fight pays nothing and opens no wave
verification: lune run tests/run: 810 pass (6 new in StationIntro.spec: the loan team's classes, the fight won untouched in 30 to 150 s with every legend above half health, won even without the blessing, the starter eggs given once and hatching in 5 s, surviving a save, old saves skipping it).
